First, I need to recall what lice are. Head lice are tiny parasitic insects that live on the scalp and can spread through direct contact or sharing personal items like combs, brushes, hats, etc. So if someone has lice, using their hair brush could transfer the lice to another person.

The scenario says he's going to lend his sister his hair brush. Since he has lice, sharing the brush would likely pass the lice to his sister. Now, morally, is it acceptable to knowingly share something that can spread an infestation to another person?
